agyos_skill.intent: Interact with Deepnote collaborative notebooks via its MCP server. Create, edit, and execute Python and SQL notebooks; manage projects, folders, integrations (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres), Streamlit apps, and compute machines programmatically from any AI agent or coding assistant.
agyos_skill.instructions: Drive the full Deepnote collaborative data science platform through its MCP server (`@deepnote/mcp`). Create notebooks, run Python and SQL blocks, inspect outputs, manage integrations, and deploy Streamlit apps — all from an AI agent. **Package:** `@deepnote/mcp` (official, run via `npx`) **Auth options:** - **API key** (recommended for agents): Generate under *Workspace → Settings & members → Security → API keys*. Store as `DEEPNOTE_API_KEY`. - **OAuth**: For interactive clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor) pointing to `https://deepnote.com/mcp` — triggers browser sign-in automatically. The AGYOS `mcp_config.json` registers this as `deepnote-mcp` using `${DEEPNOTE_API_KEY}`. Set before starting Antigravity: ```bash export DEEPNOTE_API_KEY="your_api_key_here" ``` | Domain | Tools | Mode | |--------|-------|------| | **Account & workspace** | `get_me`, `search`, `list_projects`, `list_folders`, `create_folder` | Read / Write | | **Projects** | `get_project`, `create_project`, `update_project`, `delete_project`, `generate_project_url` | Read / Write | | **Notebooks** | `get_notebook`, `create_notebook`, `update_notebook`, `duplicate_notebook`, `delete_notebook` | Read / Write | | **Blocks** | `get_block`, `create_block`, `update_block`, `delete_block`, `reorder_notebook_blocks` | Read / Write | | **Runs (execution)** | `create_run`, `get_run`, `list_notebook_runs` | Write | | **Integrations** | `list_integrations`, `get_integration`, `attach_integration`, `detach_integration` | Read / Write | | **Apps** | `create_streamlit_app`, `list_streamlit_apps`, `get_streamlit_app_status`, `create_data_app_token` | Write | | **Machines** | `restart_machine`, `update_machine`, `list_machine_types`, `list_environments` | Write | > [!NOTE] > Read-only tools (`get_*`, `list_*`, `search`) require only viewer access. Write and execution tools require editor access or an API key with edit permissions. 1. **Confirm auth** — call `get_me` to verify the API key is valid and check permission level. 2. **Locate resources** — use `list_projects` or `search` to find the target project and notebook. Note the IDs. 3. **Inspect the notebook** — call `get_notebook` to understand existing block structure before making changes. 4. **Make changes** — use `create_block` / `update_block` / `reorder_notebook_blocks` as needed. Keep changes minimal and scoped.
